messages:
maria: Cutting RC rc-2026-03-22-1 for payment-service now. Artifact: sha=abc123def. Dropping release-notes draft below. Please ack DB migration window and rollback plan.

devon: ACK. I'll gate the DB migration behind the feature flag and a staged run. Setting migration_lock until 23:00 PT.

lisa: FYI change window 22:00-02:00 PT. Recommend canary at 22:15 with 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% then full. @eng-sre please confirm.

deploybot: [deploybot] rc create successful — tag=rc-2026-03-22-1, artifact=abc123def, manifest=/artifacts/payment-service/rc-2026-03-22-1.yaml

maria: Rollback criteria proposal: if p95 latency > 350ms for 10m OR error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute for 5m, auto-fallback to rc-2026-03-21-9. Manual abort override allowed by oncall.

devon: Sounds good. I'll add the p95 check to the alerting rule and wire the deadman switch. Also adding a pre-promo KV-warm step: warm caches for 10m before traffic shift.

sam: Sheriff here — I'll take post-promo oncall for the first 2 hours. Please tag me @sam when you start canary.

maria: QA note: test vectors for checkout + refunds are in the PR. @qa-bot run smoke tests once canary is live.

qa-bot: [qa-bot] queued: smoke-suite/payments referenced in RC. Will run after initial canary flip. Results posted here.

lisa: Ops checklist: 1) pin artifact in deploy registry 2) set feature flag to gradual 3) KV warm 4) kick canary 5) monitor dashboards 6) promote. I'll handle steps 1-3.

deploybot: [deploybot] command preview:
```
# warm caches
./deployctl warm --service payment-service --tag rc-2026-03-22-1 --duration 10m
# canary
./deployctl promote --service payment-service --tag rc-2026-03-22-1 --traffic 5% --canary
```

maria: Adding release notes snippet:
- payments: improved retry handling and concurrency trimming
- migration: payments.transactions schema bump (backwards compatible)

devon: One more thing — migration requires an index build that might spike IO for ~3m. I'll schedule that during warm period and throttle.

lisa: All set on registry pin. Tag rc-2026-03-22-1 locked.

sam: ACK. I'll watch the p95 dashboard during canary. If we hit the threshold I will initiate rollback.

maria: Final signoff: maria ✅, devon ✅, lisa ✅, sam ✅. Promo scheduled at 22:15 PT. @deploybot please execute canary at that time and post results.

deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled: promote rc-2026-03-22-1 at 2026-03-22T22:15:00-07:00, canary plan=5m->25m->100%, kv_warm=10m, rollback_target=rc-2026-03-21-9

lisa: Audit note: added changelog entry + link to migration playbook in the deployment ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEPLOY-4521

maria: Thanks all. Radio-silence window enabled from 22:00-23:00 — no non-emergency merges. :lock: 

devon: I'll post a quick post-mortem template in case we need to rollback.

maria: Promo in flight tomorrow night. Good luck everyone :rocket:
